acknowledge_message.description: Acknowledge a message (private NIP-17 ack, idempotent).

message_id.description:
toron message id = the rumor's content-addressed hex EventId (NOT an
AM-style integer sequence). The arg is a string to match toron's own
id model — `fetch_inbox` returns `id` as hex; this accepts it verbatim.
(known-divergences §1: id-type differs by design per ADR-0003.)

acquire_build_slot.description: Acquire an advisory build-slot lease (kind-30032), optionally exclusive.

ask_judgment.description: Ask flywheel judgment math (effect_key + pack_id + state in, typed answers + journaled JudgmentEffect out; idempotent replay on effect_key). Offline transport is pure; system-one reaches a live model API.

effect_key.description: Idempotency key: a recorded key replays the stored row, no re-invoke.

pack_id.description: Flywheel resolves the question pack (unknown pack = typed error).

check_file_reservation_conflicts.description: Symmetric-glob conflict report for paths vs other agents' reservations.

reservation_ids.description:
Kind-30031 event id of each conflicting lease — parallel to
`holders`, one id per holder. The operator lock board surfaces these
for diagnostics (force-release, request-release, replay).

slot_holders.description:
ACTIVE build-slot leases held by others — "is the cargo fence free?"
in the same one-call pre-write check.

soft_conflicts.description:
ADR-0011 Spec 4: additive soft tier — other agents' in-TTL intents AND
their live shared leases. Neither blocks; both mean "someone is here".
A path listed in `clear_paths` is one nobody holds or declared.

cleanup_pane_identities.description: Prune identities whose herdr panes are absent from the live pane list.

ReleasedGhostOut.description:
One exclusive lease revoked because its holder pin was pruned: a dead pin
must not own the ledger.

create_agent_identity.description: Mint a fresh agent keypair (ncryptsec) and publish the kind-30013 profile.

model.description:
Model (maps to 30013 content `model`). Optional for backward compat
(ADR-0005 P2.2 content-map).

program.description:
Harness / program (maps to 30013 content `program`). Optional for
backward compat — old callers omit it (ADR-0005 P2.2 content-map).

ensure_product.description: Idempotent product manifest (kind-30011) for a product key.

fetch_inbox.description: Project the agent's inbox (rumor-time order, G7). unread_only is accepted but a no-op (no read-state filter); ack_overdue_only keeps ack-required high/urgent posts past the 30m SLA the recipient has not read. Use since_ts / thread_id to scope.

ack_overdue_only.description:
Implemented: keeps ack-required high/urgent posts older than the
30m ack SLA that this recipient has not read. Same rule as the
ack-sla scan, applied post-projection.

thread_id.description: Keep only messages in this thread.

unread_only.description:
Accepted but a no-op (schema only): the projection carries no read
state, so every fetch returns all matching rows. Scope with since_ts.

duplicate_of.description:
The first id of the duplicate group this row survives for; `null` =
standalone message.

read_ts_us.description:
Read receipt timestamp (i64-µs) from the `message_reads` projection;
`null` = unread.

verdict.description: HumanDecision live producer: `verdict=` extra_tag on the rumor.

fetch_inbox_product.description: Fan an inbox fetch across a product's member projects.

corr.description:
ADR-0027 E2 assignment tags; flattened mirror of `InboxMessageOut`
tags. Optional, `null` = untasked.

file_reservation_paths.description: Acquire exclusive/shared leases on path globs (kind-30031).

transfer_from.description: When set, this call is a `transfer_reservation` (`agent_name` = to).

reservation_ids.description:
Kind-30031 event id of each conflicting lease — parallel to
`holders`, one id per holder. The operator lock board surfaces these
for diagnostics (force-release, request-release, replay).

soft_conflicts.description: ADR-0011 Spec 4: additive soft tier (frozen-acquire paths).

force_release_file_reservation.description: Operator force-release of a stale reservation (staleness heuristic + revocation).

holder.description:
Optional holder name to disambiguate when multiple holders match the
path. Omit to revoke the (single) matching lease.

path.description:
Path (or glob) of the stale reservation to revoke. The daemon resolves
the active lease on this path itself — the caller does NOT need the
holder's event id.

health_check.description: Bus liveness + archive health for a project (AM-Rust parity).

project_key.description:
AM parity: `health_check` takes no required args. The field is kept
optional (default empty) so clients that mirror the project-scoped
convention still parse, but it is NOT required and NOT used — the
daemon reports process-global bus + archive health.

install_precommit_guard.description: Install the toron pre-commit hook in a git repository.

list_agents.description: List a project's agents with npub + last-active provenance.

WhoIsOut.description:
`whois`: `{name, npub, program, model, task_description, last_active_ts_us,
stale, pane_id, workspace_id, tab_id}`.

ADR-0010 F2: `stale` flags roster rows older than the prune cadence —
never a silent live pin.

`pane_id`/`workspace_id`/`tab_id` are the LIVE herdr pane the pin runs in
(advisory; all `None` when no herdr backend is reachable). Additive
optionals, so a client that predates them parses rows unchanged.

`pane_npub`/`identity_divergent` are the identity-health pair (u31k): the
npub stamped on that live pane vs this row's npub. Divergent means mail
addressed to the NAME reaches a key the pane does not read — re-register
the pin or address it by npub. Advisory, never a routing gate.

list_contacts.description: List an agent's contact links (AgentLink rows). Link status is the social graph (pending|approved|denied) — it does NOT gate mail. Delivery is gated by the RECIPIENT's contact policy (kind-30014, see set_contact_policy, default auto): a pending link still receives mail unless the recipient's policy blocks it.

ContactLinkOut.description:
`request_contact` / `respond_contact` / `list_contacts` rows.

Link rows describe the SOCIAL GRAPH — they do not gate mail. Inbound
delivery is gated by the recipient's contact policy (kind-30014, default
`auto`): a `pending` link still receives mail unless the recipient's
policy blocks it.

status.description: pending | approved | denied — social graph state, not a delivery gate.

list_file_reservations.description: List every active (held) file reservation in the project — the lock board the strict guard evaluates: id, path glob, holder, exclusive, reason, expiry. Optional filters: holder (exact agent name), path (glob overlap). REQUIRED: project_key.

path.description: glob-overlap filter (show holders of one path)

macro_contact_handshake.description: Batch: request contact + optional auto-accept + welcome message.

ContactLinkOut.description:
`request_contact` / `respond_contact` / `list_contacts` rows.

Link rows describe the SOCIAL GRAPH — they do not gate mail. Inbound
delivery is gated by the recipient's contact policy (kind-30014, default
`auto`): a `pending` link still receives mail unless the recipient's
policy blocks it.

status.description: pending | approved | denied — social graph state, not a delivery gate.

macro_file_reservation_cycle.description: Batch: reserve a set of path globs, optionally release them at the end.

macro_prepare_thread.description: Batch: ensure registration + thread summary + recent inbox context.

macro_start_session.description: Batch: ensure_project + register agent + optional file reservation + inbox snapshot.

mark_message_read.description: Mark a message read (private NIP-17 read receipt, idempotent).

message_id.description: See [`AcknowledgeMessageArgs::message_id`] — hex event id, not an int.

products_link.description: Link a project into a product (idempotent; kind-30011 a-tag).

register_agent.description: Upsert an agent identity on its existing key (or create if absent).

alias.description: Herdr slug (or other alias) to fold onto `name` (the pin).

model.description:
Model (maps to 30013 content `model`). Optional for backward compat
(ADR-0005 P2.2 content-map).

program.description:
Harness / program (maps to 30013 content `program`). Optional for
backward compat — old callers omit it (ADR-0005 P2.2 content-map).

release_file_reservations.description: Release the holder's active file reservations (idempotent).

release_file_reservations_by_reason.description:
Release all file reservations whose reason is the given bead id (operator-signed; release-on-bead-close). REQUIRED: project_key, agent_name, bead_id. Operator/loop after-close hook; crews release their own locks via release_file_reservations (by agent_name) or CLI: toron reserve release --project

--as . Operator CLI door: toron reserve release-by-reason --project

--as .

agent_name.description: Requestor (operator-facing name; used in the holder notification DM).

bead_id.description: Bead id whose matching (reason == bead id) leases get revoked.

renew_build_slot.description: Extend an active build-slot lease's TTL (no-op when missing).

renew_file_reservations.description: Extend the TTLs of the holder's active file reservations.

reply_message.description: Reply to a message within its thread (NIP-10 reply reference). REQUIRED: project_key, sender_name (your adjective+noun pin), to[], subject, body_md. Thread context comes from args (thread_id) - no auto-parent resolution on toron; the flywheel facade resolves it.

request_message_id.description: When set, this call is a `respond_request_release` (CLI compose).

reservation_note.description: Optional note on the response rumor.

request_contact.description: Request contact with another agent (AgentLink + NIP-17 control message).

status.description: pending | approved | denied — social graph state, not a delivery gate.

resolve_pane_identity.description: Resolve a pane/terminal id to the agent name (G9).

respond_contact.description: Approve or deny a pending contact request.

status.description: pending | approved | denied — social graph state, not a delivery gate.

search_messages.description: FTS5 search over a project's indexed messages (porter/unicode61).

search_messages_product.description: Fan an FTS5 search across a product's member projects.

send_message.description: Send a NIP-17 gift-wrapped message to one or more recipients. REQUIRED: project_key, sender_name (your adjective+noun pin), to[], subject, body_md. Shell available? Prefer: flywheel mail send <proj> --to <names> --subject S --body B.

corr.description: ADR-0027 E2: correlation id rides extra_tags corr.

reservation_id.description: When set, this call is a `request_release` (CLI compose; no new tool).

reservation_note.description: Optional note on the request-release rumor.

result_path.description: ADR-0027 E2: result_path rides extra_tags result_path.

set_contact_policy.description: Set the agent's inbound contact policy (open|auto|contacts_only|block_all).

summarize_thread.description: Deterministic digest of a thread (participants, key points, actions).

summarize_thread_product.description: Summarize a thread across a product's member projects.

uninstall_precommit_guard.description: Remove the toron pre-commit hook (never clobbers a user hook).

whois.description: Resolve an agent name to npub + profile fields (fail-fast on unknown).

agent_name.description:
The identity to look up: a REGISTERED adjective+noun pin, canonical
name, folded alias, or npub. `name` is accepted as a serde alias
(grok/other wrappers pass `name`); the field stays REQUIRED (both
missing fails — never defaults to $USER or a generated pin).
